glossary.definition: (B) As used in this section, "encumbrance" means an easement, covenant, condition, restriction, community development charges, or similar encumbrance relating to real property within a new community district.
glossary.source_title: Section 349.071 - Class actions affecting encumbrance relating to real property within new community district.
